mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.status, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.promo_code, o.currency, o.created_at, o.updated_at, e.id AS event_id, e.name AS event_name, e.start_time AS event_start_time, v.name AS venue_name, v.timezone AS venue_timezone, (c.event_id IS NOT NULL) AS event_cancelled, c.reason AS cancellation_reason, f.amount AS refund_amount, f.reason AS refund_reason, f.created_at AS refunded_at FROM orders o JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id JOIN events e ON e.id = r.event_id JOIN venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id LEFT JOIN event_cancellations c ON c.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN refunds f ON f.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
